Dubai Chocolate With 5 Different Nuts! 🍫🥜💚 Ingredients 200 g milk chocolate 80 g kataifi pastry (shredded filo dough) 120 g pistachio cream 30 g butter 50 g pistachios 20 g almonds 20 g hazelnuts 20 g cashews 10 g walnuts Instructions Melt the butter in a pan over medium-low heat. Add the kataifi pastry and fry for 5–7 minutes until golden brown and crispy. Chop all the nuts into small pieces. Mix the toasted kataifi with the pistachio cream and all the chopped nuts. Melt 200 g of milk chocolate in the microwave in 20-second intervals, stirring between each interval. Spread a layer of melted chocolate inside a chocolate bar mold, covering the bottom and sides. Refrigerate for 10–15 minutes until the chocolate shell is firm. Add the pistachio and mixed-nut filling, spreading it evenly without filling all the way to the edges. Cover the filling with the remaining melted chocolate and smooth the top. Refrigerate for 45–60 minutes until completely set. Remove the chocolate bar from the mold, cut it in half, and reveal the crunchy mixed-nut filling. #recipe #easyrecipe #foodtok #asmrchocolate #dubaichocolate

You don’t need to punish yourself for eating Halloween candy 🎃 I’m not suggesting you sit down and eat 3,500 calories worth of mini chocolate bars 😂🍫 BUT here’s something worth understanding… It takes roughly 3,500 calories ABOVE what your body burns to gain one pound of body fat.  So if your body burns 2,000 calories a day, eating 2,300 calories doesn’t mean you’ve ruined your progress. And if the scale jumps the next morning? 👀 That’s not necessarily fat gain! Extra carbs, sodium, food volume and water retention can temporarily increase your weight. Here’s my Halloween advice: 🍫 Eat the chocolates you actually LOVE. Don’t waste calories on the crappy ones 😂 💪 Eat your normal meals. Don’t skip breakfast or lunch to “save calories.” 🚶‍♀️ Move because it feels good, not because you need to punish yourself. ❤️ November 1st? Get right back to your normal routine. No detoxes. No extra cardio. No guilt. One night of Halloween candy won’t undo months of consistency. But the guilt restrict overeat cycle can make progress a whole lot harder. Enjoy Halloween. Make memories. Eat the damn chocolate 👻 What’s the ONE Halloween chocolate you can’t resist? 👇🍫
